item.title: Explain Unused Rehearsal Bookings
item.prompt_text: In the last four weeks, rehearsal groups reserved 90 room slots, but staff logged arrivals for 63 of them. Fourteen of the unused bookings were cancelled at least a day ahead. The centre is considering a reminder with an easy cancellation link or charging a small fee for late cancellations. Recommend a first step and explain how the manager could judge whether it helped.
item.target_grammar: Reported numbers; hedging with may, could and appears; if clauses.
item.target_structure: Heading → findings → interpretation → recommendation and measure.

checklist.point: Distinguish bookings, arrivals and early cancellations.
Explain what the figures can and cannot show.
Choose one first step with a reason.
Name a measurable result for the trial.
